context: Dispatch on develop with the benchmark input set to a single cheap benchmark first - that also exercises the SELECTED env filter #1320 introduced, confirming selected steps run and unselected ones skip. Inspect the run for real job output rather than a green tick. Only then consider an unfiltered dispatch: NEEDS JOE'S OK, since SF 1.0 TPC-DS entries can take 30+ minutes each across 8 matrix jobs at a 60-minute timeout. Finally decide whether a schedule trigger or a documented manual cadence is needed so the corpus does not silently rot - today nothing ever runs it.
description: Seed Corpus has never executed a single job. Every run in its history is event=push, conclusion=failure, jobs=[] - phantom startup failures GitHub recorded while validating an invalid workflow file. Queried directly: zero runs with conclusion=success ever, zero runs with event=workflow_dispatch ever. PR #1320 fixed the startup failure and post-fix pushes correctly produce no runs (5 develop pushes, zero seed-corpus runs), but that proves only that the file parses and no longer fails at startup. The eight matrix entries (tpch/tpcds across duckdb, datafusion, polars-df and clickhouse-cloud, sf 0.01-1.0) have never been exercised, so the corpus is not being generated and the workflow body is unverified. Separately, the rung on verify-seed-corpus-recovery-post-1320 was unusable: 'gh run list --jq -e EXPR' is malformed (gh consumes -e as the expression and exits with usage), and asserting on the latest automatic develop run can never pass for a dispatch-only workflow.
